header_text: No Ronkonkoma service between Hicksville and Farmingdale because of downed utility poles west of Bethpage.
header_html: No Ronkonkoma service between Hicksville‌ and Farmingdale‌ because of downed utility poles west of Bethpage.
description_text:
Train service is operating in two sections:
In both directions between Manhattan and Hicksville 
In both directions between Farmingdale and Ronkonkoma
There is no train service at Bethpage
There are cancellations and scattered delays as well. Customers are advised to use alternate branches where possible, including the Port Jefferson, Babylon, and Montauk branches.

The 9:01pm train from Penn Station to Hicksville is canceled. Take the 9:15pm train from Penn Station to Huntington for service to Hicksville.

All eastbound trains will terminate at Hicksville , and there will be limited service operating between Farmingdale and Ronkonkoma.
Reduced westbound service will operate from Ronkonkoma, and will terminate at Farmingdale. Some extra trains trains will operate west from Hicksville .

Use our TrainTime app or visit mta.info for the latest updates and schedule changes.
